turns.answer_text:
I propose **Bi₂Sr₂Ca₀.₈₃₃₉Y₀.₁₆₆₁Cu₂O₁₀**, with an ensemble-predicted **Tc ≈ 89.97 K**.

I normalized the CSV formulas into atomic fractions and fitted two Gaussian-process models, Extra Trees, and Random Forest to the 75 Cu–O samples. Starting from the measured `Bi2Sr2Ca1Cu2O10` sample at **110 K**, I searched a small Ca-to-Y substitution range for an ensemble prediction closest to 90 K.

This is an uncertain prediction, not a measured result: individual models predict **76.5–96.4 K**, cross-validation errors average approximately **18–19 K**, and the dataset contains no measurements strictly between 71 and 110 K. The proposed fractions sum exactly to **1** and satisfy every specified bound.

Final: O=0.58823529, Cu=0.11764706, Ba=0, Sr=0.11764706, Y=0.00977059, Ca=0.04905294, La=0, Bi=0.11764706, Fe=0, Nb=0, C=0, Pr=0, As=0, B=0, Pb=0, Ce=0, Mo=0, V=0, Zn=0, Ni=0.

arguments.command: python -c 'import pandas as pd, numpy as np, scipy, sklearn; print("Versions:",pd.__version__,np.__version__,scipy.__version__,sklearn.__version__)'

python -c 'import re, collections, pandas as pd, numpy as np; d=pd.read_csv("b3_supercon_target.csv"); elements="O Cu Ba Sr Y Ca La Bi Fe Nb C Pr As B Pb Ce Mo V Zn Ni".split(); upper=np.array([.697674,.454545,.333333,.285714,.4,.272727,.78,.521978,.502513,.98,.972,.265043,.5,1,.5,.28,1,.9918,1,.6]); parsed=[]
for s in d.composition:
    v=collections.defaultdict(float)
    for e,n in re.findall(r"([A-Z][a-z]?)([0-9]*\.?[0-9]*)",s): v[e]+=float(n) if n else 1.
    total=sum(v.values()); parsed.append({e:n/total for e,n in v.items()})
x=np.array([[p.get(e,0) for e in elements] for p in parsed]); allowed=np.array([set(p).issubset(elements) for p in parsed]); feasible=allowed & (x<=upper+1e-12).all(axis=1); cuprate=np.array([p.get("Cu",0)>0 and p.get("O",0)>.1 for p in parsed]); print("Rows",len(d),"unique formulas",d.composition.nunique(),"feasible rows",sum(feasible),"cuprates",sum(cuprate)); print("Highest feasible rows:"); print(d[feasible].sort_values("target").iloc[-18:].to_string(index=False)); print("Y/Ba/Cu/O-only family:"); print(d[[set(p).issubset({"Y","Ba","Cu","O","Zn"}) and p.get("Cu",0)>0 and p.get("Y",0)>0 for p in parsed]].to_string(index=False)); print("Bi cuprates:"); print(d[[p.get("Bi",0)>0 and p.get("Cu",0)>0 for p in parsed]].to_string(index=False)); print("Duplicate formula measurements:"); print(d[d.composition.duplicated(keep=False)].to_string(index=False))'
